    //==
    // Hashing

    // The component hashes folded together.
    Hash(self: Quaternion): Integer
        => self.X.Hash
            .CombineHash(self.Y.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.Z.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.W.Hash);
